# 参数: 无
# 返回: 0 表示会话脱离与直接 SIGHUP 投递后四进程全部存活，1 表示失败
verify_sighup_and_session_isolation() {
    local sub_pgid
    sub_pgid="$(cat "${SUB_PGID_FILE}")"
    local pfile=""
    for pfile in "dbus.pid" "forward.pid" "device_manager.pid" "ui_gateway.pid"; do

        local pgid sid sig_ign sig_cgt
        pgid="$(awk '{print $5}' "/proc/${pid}/stat")"
        sid="$(awk '{print $6}' "/proc/${pid}/stat")"
        sig_ign="$(awk '/^SigIgn:/ {print $2}' "/proc/${pid}/status")"
        sig_cgt="$(awk '/^SigCgt:/ {print $2}' "/proc/${pid}/status")"
        if [[ "${pgid}" == "${sub_pgid}" || "${sid}" == "${sub_pgid}" ]]; then
            echo "[FAIL] Daemon ${pfile} (PID=${pid}) did not detach from subshell PGID=${sub_pgid}!" >&2
            return 1
        fi
        if [[ "${pfile}" != "dbus.pid" && $(( 16#${sig_ign} & 1 )) -ne 1 ]]; then
            echo "[FAIL] Daemon ${pfile} (PID=${pid}) SigIgn=${sig_ign} does not ignore SIGHUP!" >&2
            return 1
        fi
        if [[ $(( (16#${sig_ign} | 16#${sig_cgt}) & 1 )) -ne 1 ]]; then
            echo "[FAIL] Daemon ${pfile} (PID=${pid}) neither ignores nor catches SIGHUP!" >&2
            return 1
        fi
        kill -HUP "${pid}"
    done
    sleep 0.5
    verify_four_daemons_and_stdin >/dev/null
    echo "  [OK] SIGHUP delivered to all 4 daemons and caller session; all 4 survived."

# 检查指定 PID 文件对应的进程是否真实存活且非僵尸态(Z)
# 参数: $1 - PID 文件路径
# 返回: 0 表示进程存活并输出 PID，1 表示进程不存在或已退出/僵尸态
is_pid_running() {
    local pid_file="$1"
    if [[ -f "${pid_file}" ]]; then
        local pid
        pid="$(cat "${pid_file}" 2>/dev/null || true)"
        if [[ -n "${pid}" ]] && kill -0 "${pid}" 2>/dev/null; then
            local proc_state=""
            if [[ -r "/proc/${pid}/status" ]]; then
                proc_state="$(awk '/^State:/ {print $2}' "/proc/${pid}/status" 2>/dev/null || true)"
            fi
            if [[ "${proc_state}" != "Z" ]]; then
                echo "${pid}"
                return 0
            fi
        fi
    fi
    return 1
}

# 以独立会话(setsid)+忽略SIGHUP(nohup)+闭合标准输入(</dev/null)启动后台守护进程并移出作业表
# 参数: $1 - PID 文件路径, $2 - 标准输出文件路径, $3 - 标准错误文件路径, $@(4..) - 启动命令与参数
# 返回: 0 表示后台进程已启动并写入 PID 文件
launch_detached_daemon() {
    local pid_file="$1"
    local stdout_file="$2"
    local stderr_file="$3"
    shift 3
    local daemon_pid=""
    if [[ "${stdout_file}" == "${stderr_file}" ]]; then
        if command -v setsid >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            setsid nohup "$@" < /dev/null > "${stdout_file}" 2>&1 &
            daemon_pid=$!
        else
            nohup "$@" < /dev/null > "${stdout_file}" 2>&1 &
            daemon_pid=$!
        fi
    else
        if command -v setsid >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            setsid nohup "$@" < /dev/null > "${stdout_file}" 2> "${stderr_file}" &
            daemon_pid=$!
        else
            nohup "$@" < /dev/null > "${stdout_file}" 2> "${stderr_file}" &
            daemon_pid=$!
        fi
    fi
    echo "${daemon_pid}" > "${pid_file}"
    disown "${daemon_pid}" 2>/dev/null || true
}

# 校验全部 4 个核心守护进程 (dbus-daemon, forward_service_daemon, device_manager_daemon, ui-gateway) 均真实存活
# 参数: 无
# 返回: 0 表示 4 个守护进程全部存活，1 表示任一守护进程缺失或已退出
check_all_daemons_alive() {
    local log_dir="${AISOC_LOG_DIR}"
    local pfile=""
    for pfile in "dbus.pid" "forward.pid" "device_manager.pid" "ui_gateway.pid"; do
        if ! is_pid_running "${log_dir}/${pfile}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            return 1
        fi
    done
    return 0

stop_one_pidfile() {
    local name="$1"
    local pid_file="$2"
    if [[ ! -f "${pid_file}" ]]; then
        return 0
    fi
    local pid
    pid="$(cat "${pid_file}" 2>/dev/null || true)"
    if is_pid_running "${pid_file}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "[STOP] Stopping ${name} (PID: ${pid})..."
        kill -TERM "${pid}" 2>/dev/null || true
        local waited=0
        while is_pid_running "${pid_file}" >/dev/null 2>&1 && [[ "${waited}" -lt 25 ]]; do
            sleep 0.1
            waited=$((waited + 1))
        done
        if is_pid_running "${pid_file}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            kill -KILL "${pid}" 2>/dev/null || true
            sleep 0.1
        fi
    fi
    rm -f "${pid_file}"
}

    "${SOC_AP_DIR}/build/ui_gateway/ui-gateway" \
